notes: Created comprehensive implementation plan covering three feature specifications: (1) Enhanced Title Features - movable title box, resizable width, opacity controls, alignment within configured width; (2) Move Layout to Left Sidebar - relocate Layout section, make Image Library collapsible; (3) Link to Home - toolbar navigation link. Plan includes 7 phases with BDD scenarios at user behavior, component behavior, and pure function levels. Consulted @world-review for UX perspective (edit vs drag distinction, accidental drag prevention, empty sidebar states, security attributes) and @planner for technical design (TitleInteraction.js module, computeBounds pure function, globalAlpha rendering, PanelSwap coordination). Key files analyzed: TitleRenderer.js, TitleManager.js, TitleStyle.js, PanelSwap.js, createCollageData.js, createCollageLifecycle.js, createSettingsHandlers.js, SettingsPersistence.js, createRenderMethods.js, CollageAssembler.js, index.html, Style.css.
